name: Negative impact of scarcity communications on psychological wellbeing
fact: Exposure to scarcity communications can significantly deteriorate consumer psychological wellbeing compared to surplus conditions.

provenance.title: The Role of Scarcity Communications in Retailing on Consumer Behavior and Psychological Wellbeing
provenance.quote_or_locus: scarcity communications, as opposed to surplus—that we use as a control condition—can significantly affect consumers’ psychological well-being, by deteriorating it
